Clean Windows machine without VC runtime not tested; official external prerequisite is mandatory.
Only the current Windows/GPU is tested; no hardware-universal claim.

Standalone PYTHON.json has stale Tcl/OpenSSL link names and Linux libffi metadata; actual PE imports and pinned Windows build recipe override them. Expat is CPython-vendored 2.8.2, not global recipe expat 2.8.4.

packaging_regression.failure: Removing all Microsoft DLLs initially broke NumPy because it imports a wheel-hash-renamed MSVCP DLL absent from System32.
packaging_regression.resolution: Runtime hook copies only the installed System32 msvcp140.dll to its import alias inside the process-private extraction directory. No Microsoft DLL is redistributed, no OS files/settings modified.
packaging_regression.verified_by: All final frozen QA runs exit 0 on the same final EXE hash.
